title: Segment Manager
description:
Position Details

Job Title: Segment Sales Manager — Short Range

Product Focus: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE & Short-Range Connectivity

Department: Sales — Latin America

Function: Segment Sales / Business Development

Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM

Region: Latin America (LATAM)

Location: Brazil — supporting the LATAM region

Work Arrangement: (Hybrid / Remote)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory

Role Objective

Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for Short Range products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating Wi-Fi/Bluetooth design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand Short Range penetration within the existing customer base.

Primary Responsibilities

Market Growth & New Business

  • Own LATAM growth for Quectel Short Range products, with dedicated focus on customer acquisition, new verticals and market-share expansion.
  • Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value and design-win potential.
  • Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to add Short Range solutions to active accounts.
  • Develop account strategies for customers designing connected products that require Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE or other short-range wireless connectivity.

Customer & Design-Win Development

  • Understand customer applications, connectivity architecture, product requirements, qualification process and commercial expectations, and position the most relevant Short Range solution.
  • Track samples, technical evaluations, platform discussions, qualifications and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel.
  • Initiate and schedule roadmap meetings to identify future products and position Quectel early in the customer design cycle.
  • Maintain strong follow-up from first engagement through technical validation, commercial negotiation and conversion.

Sales Enablement & Channel Development

  • Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms and distributors on the Short Range portfolio, target applications, competitive positioning and sales messages.
  • Support local sales teams with account strategy, opportunity qualification and customer-facing positioning for Wi-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity solutions.
  • Share use cases, competitive intelligence and market insights that help the wider sales organization recognize and win Short Range opportunities.

Product & Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, roadmap needs, feature gaps and competitive positioning.
  • Translate customer and market feedback into actionable input for product planning, technical support and commercial strategy.
  • Coordinate internal resources to advance strategic Short Range opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.

CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence

  • Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity and activity information in Salesforce CRM.
  • Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, customer meetings, roadmap discussions, risks and next steps.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals and major customer programs relevant to Wi-Fi/Bluetooth and short-range connectivity growth.
  • Attend trade shows and industry events to identify connected products, target accounts and new Short Range opportunities, and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.

Qualifications & Experience

What we are looking for

  • (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2B technical sales, business development or segment sales within Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, wireless modules/chipsets, semiconductors, IoT hardware or a closely related field.
  • Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue.
  • Working understanding of embedded connectivity products, customer design cycles and the commercial/technical collaboration required to win component or module business.
  • Comfort discussing Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE and short-range connectivity use cases with customers and internal technical teams.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills across a multi-country sales region.
  • Hands-on CRM discipline and ability to produce clear funnel, activity and business-review reporting.
  • Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English.
  • Ability and willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development and industry events.

Preferred background

  • Experience selling Wi-Fi/Bluetooth modules, wireless chipsets, embedded connectivity solutions, IoT modules or related semiconductor products.
  • Existing relationships within LATAM IoT, industrial, smart-home, gateway/router, POS, consumer-device or other connected-product ecosystems.
  • Experience supporting distributors, representative firms or channel partners.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management, FAE and engineering teams on technical evaluations, platform requirements and customer design-ins.

What Success Looks Like

  • Growth in qualified Short Range pipeline and new target accounts.
  • Increase in Wi-Fi/Bluetooth design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions.
  • Higher Short Range penetration across existing Quectel accounts.
  • Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through.
  • Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting.
  • Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.

Key Working Relationships

  • Regional Sales Managers (RSMs), local sales teams, representative firms and distributors.
  • Product Management, Technical/FAE teams and other internal stakeholders supporting customer design wins.
  • Customers, prospects, ecosystem partners and industry contacts across LATAM.

About Quectel

Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate IoT innovation. We are an end-to-end global IoT solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R&D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our Short Range business combines a broad Wi-Fi and Bluetooth/BLE module portfolio with regional technical support, certification services, and design-in assistance.

Industries & Applications

Quectel’s Short Range portfolio powers connected products across:

  • Smart home and consumer devices
  • Gateways, routers, and CPE
  • Point of sale and retail terminals
  • Industrial IoT and automation
  • Smart metering and utilities
  • Asset tracking and telematics
  • Healthcare and wearable devices

Why Quectel LATAM?

  • Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.
  • Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and embedded connectivity solutions in mission-critical applications.
  • Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with IoT experts across engineering, sales, and operations.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market
  • Uncapped sales commission tied to Short Range revenue and design wins in your territory
  • Meal and grocery vouchers
  • Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents
  • Dental coverage
  • Life insurance and accident cover
  • Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law
  • International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization

Learn More

Explore products, careers, and news at , or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on LinkedIn.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.

Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Product Designer
description:
Sobre a ALTAVE

Vaga PJ - Híbrida, com atuação presencial uma vez por semana em São José dos Campos

Proteger vidas e recursos com tecnologia é o propósito que nos guia.

Fundada por engenheiros do ITA, a ALTAVE atua há mais de 15 anos no desenvolvimento de soluções de videomonitoramento com inteligência artificial para redução de riscos, prevenção de acidentes e aumento da eficiência operacional.

Atendemos empresas dos setores de óleo e gás, mineração, energia, indústria e infraestrutura, com atuação no Brasil e em mercados internacionais.

Sobre os valores

Trabalhamos em um ambiente colaborativo, direto e orientado a resultados, onde autonomia vem acompanhada de responsabilidade.

  • O desafio nos inspira
  • Integridade e honestidade nas relações
  • Confiança mútua como base do trabalho
  • Autonomia com responsabilidade e excelência
  • Somos espirituosos
  • Sua missão

Na ALTAVE, o(a) Product Designer será responsável por transformar tecnologias complexas e grandes volumes de dados em experiências digitais claras, consistentes e eficientes.

Sua missão será compreender os desafios dos usuários e do negócio, projetando interfaces que facilitem a interpretação de informações e apoiem a tomada de decisão em operações críticas.

Você atuará em colaboração com Produto, Customer Success e Engenharia, conectando necessidades reais dos usuários à evolução dos produtos digitais da ALTAVE.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar jornadas, fluxos, interfaces e protótipos de média e alta fidelidade.
  • Evoluir a experiência dos usuários com base em requisitos de negócio, pesquisas, feedbacks e dados.
  • Colaborar com Product Managers, Customer Success, Engenharia e demais stakeholders na definição e validação de soluções.
  • Utilizar e evoluir o Design System da ALTAVE no Figma, garantindo consistência e escalabilidade.
  • Participar de pesquisas, entrevistas, discoveries, testes de usabilidade e análises de mercado.
  • Planejar e conduzir validações de conceitos, fluxos e protótipos com usuários e áreas internas.
  • Validar a implementação das interfaces junto ao time de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade visual e funcional.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de UX, UI, acessibilidade, arquitetura da informação e design responsivo.
  • Documentar fluxos, decisões de design, componentes e padrões utilizados nos produtos.
  • Realizar o handoff para desenvolvimento com especificações claras e completas.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Design e desenvolvimento de produto.

Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de três anos como Product Designer, UX Designer, UI Designer ou em funções relacionadas.
  • Domínio do Figma para criação de fluxos, interfaces, componentes e protótipos interativos.
  • Experiência na aplicação e evolução de Design Systems.
  • Conhecimento de UX, UI, usabilidade, acessibilidade, arquitetura da informação e design responsivo.
  • Experiência com pesquisa, definição de jornadas e validação de soluções com usuários.
  • Capacidade de transformar requisitos técnicos e de negócio em experiências claras e funcionais.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Inglês para participação em discoveries, reuniões e interações com clientes internacionais.
  • Organização, pensamento analítico, atenção aos detalhes e autonomia na condução das demandas.
  • Portfólio que demonstre processo de Design, decisões tomadas e resultados dos projetos.

Diferenciais que valorizamos

  • Experiência com produtos SaaS, B2B ou plataformas industriais.
  • Vivência com produtos que apresentam grande volume de dados, dashboards ou sistemas de monitoramento.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de produto e análise do comportamento dos usuários.
  • Familiaridade com Scrum, Kanban ou outras metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em GA4, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Glassbox ou ferramentas similares.
  • Experiência com documentação funcional e handoff para desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento básico de tecnologias front-end e limitações técnicas de implementação.
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, inteligência artificial, IoT ou videomonitoramento.

Aqui você encontra

Um ambiente tecnológico e desafiador, com espaço para propor soluções, participar de decisões de produto e trabalhar diretamente com equipes técnicas e usuários.

Você terá contato com produtos que integram inteligência artificial, videomonitoramento e análise de dados, contribuindo para tornar informações complexas mais claras e aplicáveis à rotina dos clientes.

Somos GPTW e estamos no Ranking 2025 das Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar na Indústria.

Adicionais

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico, Flash, TotalPass, Clude, day off no aniversário, entre outros benefícios.

E aí, ficou interessado(a)?

Se esse desafio faz sentido para você e para o momento da sua carreira, queremos te conhecer!

title: Especialista de Controles Internos
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsável por liderar iniciativas de estruturação, implementação e aprimoramento dos controles internos da companhia, garantindo aderência ao ambiente SOX e apoiando a construção de uma área estratégica para o negócio. Suas atividades serão:

  • Liderar o mapeamento de processos, riscos e controles internos;
  • Conduzir projetos de implementação e fortalecimento do ambiente SOX;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas de Contabilidade, Fiscal, Jurídico e Controladoria;
  • Avaliar riscos associados às demonstrações financeiras e propor controles mitigatórios;
  • Conduzir reuniões com diferentes níveis hierárquicos para entendimento de processos, identificação de riscos e desenvolvimento de soluções;
  • Revisar documentação técnica, testes de controles e relatórios executivos;
  • Apoiar a disseminação das melhores práticas de governança, controles internos e gestão de riscos;
  • Participar ativamente da estruturação e desenvolvimento do time de Controles Internos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia, Direito ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em Controles Internos, Auditoria Interna ou Auditoria Externa;
  • Forte atuação em ambientes com foco contábil, financeiro e demonstrações financeiras;
  • Experiência na identificação de riscos, avaliação de controles e desenho de soluções;
  • Conhecimento em SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley);
  • Conhecimento em processos contábeis, financeiros, fiscais ou de controladoria.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em COBIT, SoD, controles automatizados ou governança de tecnologia.
  • Experiência em Big Four;
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas.

Benefícios

  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

title: Técnico de Telecomunicações - Campo
description:
Closer to Space, Closer to the Future: venha para a Telespazio!

A Telespazio, joint venture entre Leonardo (67%) e Thales (33%), é uma líder global no setor de soluções e serviços satelitais. Fundada na Itália em 1961 e com sede em Roma, a empresa faz parte da Space Alliance, uma colaboração estratégica com a Thales Alenia Space que oferece uma ampla gama de serviços espaciais avançados.

Com mais de 3.300 profissionais distribuídos entre suas filiais na Europa e América Latina, a Telespazio opera uma rede internacional de Centros Espaciais e Teleportos, fornecendo soluções inovadoras nas áreas de Geoinformação, Sistemas e Operações Satelitais e Comunicações via Satélite.

Junte-se a nós enquanto continuamos a ultrapassar os limites do possível no espaço!

Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Telecomunicações – Campo para atuar no suporte presencial às operações da Telespazio, em ambiente de telecomunicações e comunicação via satélite. O profissional será responsável por realizar atendimentos técnicos nas estações, executando atividades de instalação, manutenção, inspeção, diagnóstico e resolução de ocorrências, garantindo o atendimento aos chamados dentro dos níveis de serviço estabelecidos e apoiando as atividades operacionais da área.

Residir em Florianópolis/SC, preferencialmente próximo à região da Tapera , com fácil deslocamento até o local de atuação.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atender chamados técnicos em campo conforme prioridade e SLA definidos.
  • Realizar inspeções, testes, diagnósticos e manutenção nos equipamentos e infraestrutura das estações.
  • Executar instalação, substituição e remoção de equipamentos, módulos, cabos, conectores e acessórios.
  • Apoiar atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva.
  • Executar medições elétricas, de conectividade e RF utilizando instrumentos apropriados.
  • Atuar em sistemas de comunicação via satélite, controle, gerenciamento e supervisão remota.
  • Realizar verificações em sistemas de alimentação, aterramento e proteção elétrica.
  • Apoiar atividades relacionadas à infraestrutura de RF e IF, cabeamento e interfaces dos equipamentos.
  • Realizar inspeções nos elementos mecânicos da antena, pedestal, plataforma, HUB e infraestrutura da sala POP.
  • Registrar as atividades executadas por meio de relatórios técnicos e evidências fotográficas, quando necessário.
  • Apoiar remotamente ou presencialmente a equipe de Operações sempre que não houver atendimento em campo.
  • Cumprir os procedimentos de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente da empresa.
  • Manter comunicação constante com a equipe de Operações durante os atendimentos.

Requisitos

Formação

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Curso Técnico completo em Eletrônica, Telecomunicações, Eletrotécnica ou áreas correlatas .

Experiência

  • Experiência comprovada em Telecomunicações, preferencialmente em comunicação via satélite .
  • Experiência em atendimento técnico em campo.
  • Experiência em instalação e/ou manutenção de equipamentos e infraestrutura de telecomunicações.
  • Conhecimentos de sistemas elétricos, redes e equipamentos eletrônicos.

Conhecimentos técnicos

  • Sistemas de comunicação via satélite.
  • Sistemas de radiofrequência (RF).
  • Sistemas de frequência intermediária (IF).
  • Cabeamento de interconexão lógica e de energia, incluindo controle, rede, RF e IF.
  • Conectores, adaptadores, guias de onda, dispositivos periféricos e interfaces locais de equipamentos.
  • Sistemas de energia: alimentação, aterramento e proteção.
  • Sistemas de controle, gerenciamento, comunicação e supervisão remota.
  • Elementos mecânicos de antenas, pedestal e plataforma.
  • HUB de antena.
  • Infraestrutura de sala POP.

Disponibilidade

  • Disponibilidade para deslocamentos na região de atuação.
  • Disponibilidade para atendimentos emergenciais, quando necessário.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação conforme demanda da operação.
  • Possuir CNH categoria B.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência anterior com comunicação via satélite.
  • Experiência em estações de telecomunicações.
  • Certificações NR-10 e NR-35.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas HVAC.

Por que a Telespazio? Na Telespazio, colocamos as pessoas no centro de tudo o que fazemos. Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, diverso e estimulante, investindo no bem-estar e no desenvolvimento de cada colaborador. Avaliamos todos os candidatos qualificados sem qualquer discriminação por raça, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

title: Consultor(a) de Implantação e Sucesso do Cliente Sênior - Latam
description:
Se sente que já domina o técnico, mas quer usar isso em algo maior do que fechar mais um balanço, essa vaga é sobre isso.

Você vai liderar a implantação dos clientes mais complexos da nossa carteira: empresas de capital aberto e fechado que publicam demonstrações financeiras e precisam de consolidação de verdade. Não é suporte, não é operação. É você junto com o cliente desenhando como a informação financeira dele vai funcionar dentro da plataforma.

O que você vai fazer

  • Ser o principal responsável técnico pela implantação dos clientes de alta complexidade do nosso canal estratégico.
  • Elaborar e revisar o layout do cliente na plataforma com total autonomia. É aqui que você traduz o plano de contas, a estrutura societária e as regras de consolidação da empresa em algo que funciona de verdade
  • Montar o cronograma de implantação e defender os prazos junto ao cliente, com revisão do Coordenador
  • Acompanhar o cliente até a conferência dos saldos consolidados e convertidos. Você não entrega e some, você fica até o número fechar
  • Elaborar DFC, DMPL e DVA em cases complexos, de empresas com demonstrações financeiras publicadas, capital aberto e fechado
  • Aplicar CPC, IFRS e consolidação em estruturas societárias que a maioria dos profissionais nunca viu de perto, incluindo conversão de moeda e múltiplas entidades
  • Participar das reuniões de decisão do projeto junto ao cliente, alinhado com o Coordenador. Você fala direto com controller, CFO e diretoria, e a sua leitura técnica faz diferença na conversa
  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes complexos, priorizando, negociando escopo e sustentando a relação ao longo do projeto
  • Gerenciar sua carteira de clientes complexos de ponta a ponta, com autonomia para priorizar, negociar escopo e sustentar a relação depois que o projeto vira. O cliente continua sendo seu
  • Monitorar o risco de cada conta com método, olhando adoção da plataforma, frequência de uso, troca de interlocutor e sinais de insatisfação. Risco identificado cedo é problema resolvido, risco identificado tarde é cliente perdido
  • Conduzir revisões periódicas com o cliente, mostrando o que a plataforma já entregou de resultado e o que ainda dá para destravar. É a conversa que renova a relação todo ciclo
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão dentro da conta, novas empresas do grupo, novos módulos, novos times que podem usar. Você enxerga antes porque conhece a estrutura por dentro;

O que precisamos que você tenha

  • Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas
  • Domínio de CPC, IFRS e normas do CFC
  • Conhecimento avançado em consolidação contábil e elaboração de demonstrações financeiras
  • Experiência real conduzindo projetos, não só participando deles
  • Excel e Word em nível avançado
  • Espanhol fluente. Requisito obrigatório , você vai conduzir reuniões e projetos nesse idioma;

Por que essa vaga é diferente

  • Tecnologia de verdade: você trabalha dentro de uma plataforma, não de uma planilha. O conhecimento técnico que você levou anos construindo vira produto, processo e escala
  • Temas estratégicos do mercado financeiro: consolidação multiempresa, conversão de moeda, estrutura de capital, tudo o que o setor olha de perto
  • IA aplicada a finanças: você vai estar perto do que existe de mais atual. Estamos construindo isso na prática, com quem entende de contabilidade participando das decisões, não recebendo o resultado pronto
  • Autonomia real: senioridade aqui significa decidir, não pedir aprovação para cada passo

title: Director of Ecommerce
description:
Company: Lime Vizio Inc.

Industry: Multi-Brand E-Commerce (US & Canada)

Location: Remote (outside the US)

Schedule: Full-time, Los Angeles business hours

Reports to: CEO & Founders

About Lime Vizio

Lime Vizio is a multi-brand e-commerce company operating across the United States and Canada.

We build and grow digital businesses in flowers, gifting, and local services, processing thousands of orders through proprietary technology, performance marketing, AI, and operational excellence.

We're looking for an experienced E-Commerce Director to drive profitable growth—not just increase traffic.

About the Role

You'll own the end-to-end digital customer journey across multiple brands, from acquisition through checkout, retention, and repeat purchase.

This is a commercial leadership role focused on improving conversion, customer experience, merchandising, experimentation, and profitability.

Success is measured by business outcomes—not website activity.

What You'll Own

  • E-commerce growth strategy
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Customer journey & UX
  • Merchandising & pricing
  • Checkout optimization
  • A/B testing & experimentation
  • Retention (Email & SMS)
  • SEO commercial performance
  • AI-powered shopping experiences
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Analytics, and Operations

Key Responsibilities

  • Increase gross profit, conversion rate, AOV, retention, and profit per visitor.
  • Build and execute the e-commerce growth roadmap.
  • Lead CRO and experimentation programs.
  • Improve customer experience across desktop and mobile.
  • Optimize merchandising, pricing, promotions, bundles, and upsells.
  • Improve customer retention and lifecycle marketing.
  • Work with PPC and SEO teams to maximize profitable growth.
  • Introduce AI-driven shopping and personalization where it creates measurable business value.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on commercial impact rather than activity.

Success Metrics

You'll be accountable for measurable improvements in:

  • Gross Profit
  • Profit per Visitor
  • Conversion Rate
  • Average Order Value
  • Checkout Completion
  • Repeat Purchase Rate
  • Customer Lifetime Value
  • Incremental Profit from Experiments

Requirements

  • 7+ years in E-commerce, CRO, Growth, or Digital Commerce.
  • 3+ years in an e-commerce leadership role.
  • Strong in-house e-commerce experience (required).
  • Proven success improving conversion, AOV, retention, or profitability.
  • Experience leading CRO, experimentation, merchandising, and customer journey optimization.
  • Strong understanding of unit economics and commercial performance.
  • Experience working with Product, Engineering, PPC, SEO, Design, and Analytics teams.
  • Excellent English (B2+).
  • Available during Los Angeles business hours.
  • Based outside the United States.

Nice to Have

  • Multi-brand e-commerce
  • Marketplace businesses
  • High-volume online retail
  • WooCommerce or Shopify
  • AI-powered personalization
  • Behavioral psychology
  • Seasonal or event-driven commerce

This Role Is Not for Someone Who

  • Only manages website content.
  • Focuses on traffic instead of profit.
  • Relies entirely on agencies.
  • Treats CRO as visual redesign.
  • Reports problems without owning implementation.
  • Measures success through clicks instead of commercial performance.

What We Offer

  • Remote, long-term leadership role.
  • Direct partnership with the CEO and founders.
  • Ownership of commercial growth strategy.
  • Fast decision-making with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Opportunity to scale multiple e-commerce brands using data, experimentation, and AI.

title: Integration Architect
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning

At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.

Integration Architect

  • (SSIS is preferred)

Skills:

  • Languages: SQL , MDX, T-SQL with knowledge of DDL, DML, stored procedures, triggers and performance tuning is a must. Leveraging ETL tools like SSIS for data transformations. Python, Bash, and/or Powershell Scripting; Amazon Web Services (AWS), AZURE, Google Cloud Infrastructures preferred.

  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.

How the process works

More about us…

At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.

With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.

o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Senior AI Agent Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research

coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.

The role

We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the

evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.

The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and

inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a

person reviews before anything happens with it.

Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,

traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.

You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've

shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea

whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.

What you'll do

• Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,

included but not limited to the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,

LangGraph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.

• Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems

are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.

• Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect

entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.

• Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to

Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.

Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.

• Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence

signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.

• Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.

Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.

• Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as

regression tests.

• Compare models against each other (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt

strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.

• Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means

generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

• Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.

Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real

users touched.

• You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about

a multi-step run.

• You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and

turned them into something an agent can call reliably.

• You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against

a structured source of truth.

• You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.

• You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and

what to do about it.

• You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question

being asked instead of a nearby one.

• You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval

for them.

• You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.

• You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the

furthest east we can go.

You might currently be titled

AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI

Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI

Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll

go on what you've shipped.

Preferred Qualifications:

• You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.

• You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, LangGraph, or the OpenAI

Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.

• You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.

• You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.

• You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

title: Immigration Paralegal (Immigration Court / Removal Defense)
description:
Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most?

If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you.

About Bueno Law

Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities.

We specialize in:

  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration.

We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact.

What You’ll Do (Removal Defense Focus)

  • Support EOIR litigation by preparing filings, motions, briefs, and applications for relief (asylum, cancellation, waivers, adjustment, etc.).
  • Draft client declarations and gather evidence for high‑stakes court submissions.
  • Manage a removal‑defense caseload, track deadlines, and maintain accurate case records.
  • Prepare hearing packets, organize exhibits, and assist attorneys with trial preparation.
  • Communicate with clients—often in emotionally sensitive situations—to collect facts and provide updates.
  • Coordinate with interpreters, experts, and agencies to support case strategy.
  • Prepare and file USCIS petitions for clients with mixed EOIR/USCIS matters.

What We’re Looking For

Hard Skills

  • Fluent in English + Spanish or Portuguese.
  • 3 years experience in with end to end removal defense (need experience with litigation).
  • Strong legal writing, research, and evidence‑gathering skills.
  • Highly organized and detail‑oriented with the ability to manage a heavy caseload.
  • Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones).

Soft Skills

  • Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments.
  • Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments.
  • Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused.
  • A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3 + years of immigration paralegal experience.
  • Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

title: Sr Sales Operations Manager - SMB
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Sales Operations Manager (IC) to join our team as the strategic engine behind our SMB merchant growth. Although this position carries a Manager title, it is a hands-on Individual Contributor (IC) role at the intersection of Sales Operations, Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy, and Analytics .

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect end-to-end merchant journey systems. Define clear entry/exit criteria, operational SOPs, and category-specific methodologies to drive merchant performance and BD team efficiency.
  • Write custom SQL queries to extract data, build tracking models, monitor key operational metrics for anomalies, and proactively uncover market opportunities without relying on external analytics teams.
  • Partner directly with Product and Growth teams to secure priority exposure, subsidy budgets, and strategic campaign placements for SMB merchants.
  • Conduct research into restaurant unit economics, menu composition, gross margins, menu design, and business workflows to distill strategic insights into practical operational checklists for BDs.
  • Formulate strategic recommendations, continuously refine SOPs, and deliver training and enablement materials that turn complex operational methodologies into high-impact sales execution.

Job Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Strategy, or Business Analytics within SMB SaaS, FoodTech, or Marketplace environments.
  • Strong, hands-on experience querying large datasets with SQL to perform root-cause analysis, measure business impact, and drive data-informed strategies.
  • Proven track record of combining sales operations with GTM strategy—identifying key leverage points in sales processes and exploring innovative partnership/commercial models around market trends.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business logic into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), structured playbooks, and training programs for BD/Sales teams.

Essa posição será volante , com atuação em toda a região DDD 16 (Ribeirão Preto e entorno) , sendo responsável pela supervisão operacional dos serviços de segurança, gestão de riscos e suporte às operações de campo.

Ao longo desses quase 30 anos, a GIF tem trabalhado incansavelmente na prevenção, detecção e combate às fraudes corporativas. Uma história marcada por confiança, dedicação, colaboração, transparência e respeito.

title: Auditor Interno
description:
Aqui, as coisas acontecem de verdade! Somos a Studio Z Ouze, uma única empresa que reúne duas marcas que estão entre as maiores do Brasil no varejo de calçados e no mercado financeiro. São mais de 100 lojas em 16 estados, um time de mais de 2 mil pessoas e um só objetivo: entregar moda e crédito acessíveis, com qualidade e agilidade.

Oferecemos o que nossos clientes precisam, sempre com inovação, energia e foco em resultados. Foi assim que começamos há 50 anos e é isso que seguimos fazendo todos os dias.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Investigar as denúncias de fraudes e desvios de conduta recebidas e recomendar as tratativas cabíveis, através de relatos no Canal de Ética ou de forma ativa, condução de entrevistas forenses e análise detalhada de trilhas de auditoria nos sistemas integrados e de documentações, visando materializar evidências robustas para subsidiar a gestão de consequências pelo Comitê de Ética, mitigar os riscos reputacionais e assegurar a conformidade ética no Grupo.
  • Solicitar e monitorar os planos de ação criados pelas áreas auditadas, por meio do acompanhamento periódico de cronogramas via sistema de governança, reuniões de status e testes de validação da eficácia dos controles mitigadores implementados, visando mitigar vulnerabilidades nos processos operacionais e financeiros, evitar a recorrência de fraudes identificadas e fortalecer o ambiente de compliance do Grupo.
  • Consolidar e registrar as denúncias recebidas por meio de todas as fontes disponíveis, como Canal de Ética, telefone, e-mail e relatos verbais, através do sistema do Canal de Ética, realização de análises analíticas preliminares e elaboração de um plano de investigação estruturado conforme a criticidade dos casos, visando garantir o tratamento isonômico de todas as manifestações, mitigar riscos de fraudes ou desvios de conduta e subsidiar com dados materiais as etapas periciais e a definição de gestão de consequência no Grupo
  • Preparar apresentações executivas com os resultados das investigações de fraudes e desvios de conduta, através da consolidação técnica e confidencial da descrição dos casos, detalhamento das abordagens periciais utilizadas e estruturação das conclusões materiais, visando subsidiar a alta gestão, o Comitê de Ética e a Diretoria Executiva na tomada de decisões estratégicas, mitigar os riscos e direcionar as deliberações finais de gestão de consequências no Grupo.
  • Desenvolver indicadores e modelos analíticos de prevenção e detecção de fraudes corporativas, através do mapeamento dos processos de negócio, análise preditiva de dados transacionais, monitoramento contínuo dos controles internos existentes e cruzamento de bases lógicas, visando identificar padrões de desvios de forma proativa, mitigar perdas financeiras antes de sua ocorrência de sinistros e dispensar a necessidade exclusiva de acionamento por denúncias no Grupo.
  • Realizar a gestão dos relatos, por meio do sistema do Canal de Ética ou por planilhas eletrônicas, considerando a criticidade e a prioridade de cada caso, de forma a buscar as resoluções com a brevidade necessária e definição de gestão de consequência.

Requisitos e qualificações:

title: Médico(a) Veterinário(a) | Desenvolvimento de Produtos
description:
#NossoJeitoDeSer

Aqui no Grupo Carrefour Brasil vivemos o #NossoJeitoDeSer todos os dias. O Cliente está no centro da Excelência em tudo o que fazemos, e é ele quem guia nossas decisões e inspira nossas entregas. Atuamos com Coragem para simplificar e Fazer acontecer, buscando soluções simples, eficientes e sustentáveis que gerem impacto real.

Nosso trabalho é construído tendo como base Compromisso com o Resultado, e com foco em Cooperar, Desenvolver e Formar nosso Time, pois sabemos que quando uma pessoa cresce, ela leva outras consigo.

E cultivamos um ambiente de Inclusão e Orgulho em Pertencer à Família, onde todas as pessoas são respeitadas, valorizadas e incentivadas a serem quem realmente são.

Se identificou com a nossa cultura e nossos valores? Então vem fazer parte do nosso time!

Sobre a área:

A área de Desenvolvimento de Produtos de Marca Própria do Carrefour tem como missão desenvolver linhas de produtos que combinem segurança, alta qualidade sensorial, sustentabilidade e acessibilidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência aos clientes. Nossa atuação é pautada em quatro pilares: rigor na seleção e formulação, garantindo produtos seguros e de alta qualidade; acessibilidade financeira, buscando a melhor relação entre qualidade e preço; responsabilidade socioambiental, promovendo soluções mais sustentáveis ao longo da cadeia; e inovação, acompanhando tendências e desenvolvendo produtos que atendam às novas necessidades dos consumidores. Com atuação nacional, os projetos podem ter abrangência nacional ou regional, de acordo com as necessidades do negócio e dos diferentes mercados.

Desafios dessa posição:

  • Definição da linha de produtos de Marca Própria a ser desenvolvida em acordo com a área comercial levando em consideração potencial de vendas, regionalidade e cluster dos consumidores;
  • Prospecção de novos fornecedores e produtos que cumprem os requisitos para produtos das marcas Carrefour, baseando-se em pesquisas de mercado (avaliação de sortimento marca nacional e concorrência, tendências de mercado, localização da produção, calibre mínimo, impactos na biodiversidade, manejo dos produtos);
  • Reuniões de alinhamento com fornecedores sobre os conceitos das marcas Carrefour e requisitos e etapas para o desenvolvimento do projeto;
  • Elaboração de briefing para início de projeto com definição de target para o produto em desenvolvimento, levando em consideração o custo, qualidade, marca e share de mercado;
  • Análise sensorial dos produtos a serem desenvolvidos, em conjunto com a equipe de qualidade e comercial, para a validação dos targets e das características organolépticas. Caso reprovados, é realizada a proposta de adequação de formulação do produto, para que este atenda às expectativas de qualidade do projeto; solicitação das amostras;
  • Follow up de fornecedores para o preenchimento da documentação necessária (Cadernos de Encargos ou Cadernos de Especificações Técnicas), e para o agendamento de auditorias e análises laboratoriais, bem como para o cumprimento de prazos de planos de ação em eventuais reprovações em análises laboratoriais ou auditorias;
  • Acompanhamento e intermediação entre agência de arte, agência de assuntos regulatórios e fornecedores, para a elaboração da rotulagem e embalagem dos produtos;
  • Visita técnica à área produtiva (entender como a produção é realizada, documentar, analisar e retornar com os dados necessários para adequação);
  • Follow up com fornecedor para o deferimento de rótulos no sistema PGA do DIPOA (Departamento de Inspeção de Produtos de Origem Animal);
  • Cadastro dos produtos (solicitação, acompanhamento e liberação de cada SKU)
  • Análise técnica das amostras de produtos a serem lançados, como última etapa de desenvolvimento, para a confirmação de que o produto final esteja de acordo com o que foi definido ao longo do projeto. (primeira produção);
  • Visita as lojas e follow up com comercial garantindo presença no PDV
  • Compreensão e resolução de questões relacionadas ao bloqueio de produtos / fornecedores
  • Elaboração e análise de indicadores de desempenho de produtos marcas Carrefour (análise de vendas em volume, margem e lucro);
  • Reuniões mensais com os times comerciais para discussão de resultados da linha atual e alinhamentos diversos dos desenvolvimentos.

Você precisa ter:

Ensino Superior em Medicina Veterinária;

Inglês avançado e/ou Fluente;

Experiência com visitas técnicas em áreas produtivas;

Conhecimento em processos de aprovação de rótulos no sistema PGA/DIPOA.

Adoraríamos se você tiver:

Experiência na área de desenvolvimento e gestão de produtos MP.

title: Analista de Planejamento Logístico Júnior

title: Analista de Impostos Júnior
description:

5. Relatórios e Controles Internos

  • Manter atualizados relatórios, planilhas e controles operacionais, apoiando o acompanhamento das rotinas fiscais e a organização das informações da área.

6. Melhoria Contínua e Aprendizado

  • Buscar aprendizado contínuo, desenvolvendo competências técnicas e comportamentais, atuando com responsabilidade, organização e atenção aos detalhes, e seguindo procedimentos, instruções de trabalho, padrões internos e diretrizes de compliance.

title: Import Export Specialist
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Trade & Compliance Specialist processes Move Order Requests (MORs) raised from the client's and third-party warehouses across multiple locations and ensures that every shipment's commercial and trade documentation is in place and compliant with shipping practice. The role carries the deep trade-compliance expertise behind the operation — managing customs clearance, ATA Carnets, dangerous goods, brokerage performance and emerging-markets shipping research — on a 16x5 hybrid model that combines onsite presence with remote processing.

Day to day, the specialist reviews and approves commercial invoices, manages location codes within the client's commercial-invoice tooling, resolves inbound shipments stuck at customs, and produces the monthly compliance reporting and audit tracking the service requires — all in line with the logistics & compliance handbook. The role partners with Order Management, logistics and the client's compliance point of contact, escalating regulatory questions where a ruling is needed.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Move Order Request (MOR) Processing

  • Manage and process Move Order Requests (MORs) and supply-chain portal requests from initial receipt through to confirmed delivery by the carrier
  • Review Order Form entries in the relevant order systems for correct entities, Incoterms and shipment details, and update order status for non-inventory shipments via the client's ticketing system.
  • Track and update fulfillment statuses for non-inventory shipments within the enterprise ticketing and order-tracking tools.
  • Monitor backlogs to proactively flag delayed shipments, identify transit issues early, and initiate swift corrective actions.

2. Trade Documentation & Compliance

  • Review and ensure all commercial documents connected with MORs are present and compliant with shipping practice, creating manual trade documents where needed.
  • Review and approve commercial invoices generated for the various order types.
  • Process, coordinate, and manage ATA Carnets globally to facilitate temporary cross-border movements of corporate hardware and demonstration equipment.
  • Draft manual trade and customs clearance documents when automated system pipelines face data errors or exceptions.
  • Conduct proactive regulatory research into shipping laws, import/export restrictions, and tax liabilities for new or expanding global delivery locations.

3. Customs & Dangerous Goods

  • Act as the primary escalation point to coordinate, troubleshoot, and resolve international inbound shipments blocked or held at global customs borders
  • Govern and approve the shipment of hazardous or restricted commodities (specifically lithium-ion batteries) globally, providing strict packaging, safety labeling, and carrier declaration guidance
  • Maintain strict database accuracy by managing location-code data and regional entity mappings within the commercial-invoice tooling.

4. Brokerage, Reporting & Continuous Compliance

  • Compile brokerage performance metrics, track transportation costs, and maintain a country-by-country compliance audit ledger to support internal audits. Maintain brokerage performance reports and manage transportation cost and performance reporting as requested.
  • Generate and present monthly reports — tickets and bugs resolved, average resolution and acknowledgment times, logistics-documentation updates, and the country-compliance audit tracker.
  • Assist the compliance manager in developing and maintaining transportation programs across regions, and provide location-code management within the client's commercial-invoice tool.
  • Comply with the processes, procedures and instructions set out in the logistics & compliance handbook, and identify and escalate system performance issues to the local support team.

PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS

Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured by location per service line.

  • Ticket Response by Priority: respond within 1 hour for P0 (urgent/high), 3 hours for P1 (normal), and 6 hours for P2/P3/P4 (low), across all regional tickets and bugs in scope.
  • Assignment Accuracy: maintain correct HS codes, ECCN designations and Certificates of Origin on ≥99% of in-scope hardware shipments.
  • Customs Compliance: keep 100% of shipments compliant with the client's policy and customs law, evidenced through the audit tracker.
  • Reporting Cadence: deliver monthly performance and compliance reports on time, with the country-compliance audit tracker kept current.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS

  • ERP Platforms: SAP (specifically Procure-to-Pay, Materials Management, and Trade Processing modules).
  • Global Logistics & Order Tools: Enterprise order-management systems, global carrier booking consoles (FedEx, DHL, freight forwarders), and warehouse portal interfaces.
  • Compliance & Invoicing Tooling: Automatic commercial-invoice generators, centralized location-code registries, and compliance database trackers.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Mandatory

  • 3–7+ years of experience in international trade, customs compliance, global logistics, or cross-border supply-chain operations.
  • Expert-level command of global import/export regulations, Harmonized System (HS) classifications, ECCN codes, Incoterms (DDP vs. DAP), and Importer/Exporter of Record (IOR/EOR) liabilities.
  • Proven experience reviewing commercial invoices and creating compliant international trade paperwork across EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and AMER regions.
  • Hands-on experience interpreting transport regulations for dangerous goods and hazardous cargos (specifically IATA/ADR battery compliance.
  • Commercial-invoice review and trade-documentation experience across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Clear English communication and audit-ready documentation discipline.

Preferred

  • Licensed customs-broker exposure or formal customs training.
  • Dangerous Goods (IATA / IMDG) certification.
  • Experience using SAP Trade/Logistics modules, international shipping portals, and automated commercial-invoice generators.
  • Emerging-markets trade experience and familiarity with global order-management and trade systems.

LEVELS & PROGRESSION (I – III)

One job profile spans the levels below; seniority (and compensation) is differentiated by scope, autonomy and ownership. The JD itself is common across levels.

  • Level II — processes MORs, prepares and reviews trade documents, and handles DG approvals within established procedures.
  • Level III — is the trade-compliance SME and line lead — owning customs escalations, brokerage governance, regional transportation programs, emerging-markets research and audit defense.

title: Digital Designer (Marketing)
description:
Overview

Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency with a growing (20+) distributed team across the U.S., Canada and Europe. We provide beginning-to-end strategy, design and production services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies.

We're looking for a Digital Designer (Marketing) to join our team and work primarily with our retainer clients. Unlike project-based work, you'll develop deep, ongoing relationships with a portfolio of clients, becoming an extension of their marketing teams and developing an intimate understanding of their brands, audiences, and business goals.

You'll report to both the Design Team Lead and Head of Creative and Strategy, working across a wide range of marketing assets. This role requires a designer who thrives on variety, works quickly without sacrificing quality, and has a deep understanding of marketing asset creation across digital channels.

Key Responsibilities
Marketing Asset Creation
  • Designing social media content across platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter/X, Facebook), including static posts, carousels, and stories
  • Creating webinar and event graphics, including promotional banners, registration pages, presentation templates, and recap assets
  • Developing one-pagers, sell sheets, and product/feature overviews

  • Creating infographics, data visualizations, and report layouts

  • Producing landing page designs and website banners
  • Creating presentation decks for sales, investors, and internal use
  • Designing trade show and event collateral (booth graphics, handouts, signage)
  • Adapting and resizing assets for multiple formats and platforms
Brand Stewardship
  • Maintaining brand consistency across all touchpoints for assigned clients
  • Building and maintaining template libraries and asset repositories
  • Contributing to design system development and documentation
  • Evolving client brands within established guidelines while keeping them fresh
Collaboration & Process
  • Working under the supervision of the Design Team Lead while maintaining direct communication with leadership
  • Collaborating closely with Account Managers to understand client priorities and deadlines
  • Managing multiple client requests simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail
  • Participating in client calls and incorporating feedback quickly

Key KPIs
  • Operational Efficiency: Deviation from estimates <10%
  • Client Satisfaction (CSAT): Average score 4.7+
  • Internal Quality Score: Average score 4.7+
  • Client Creative Feedback: Average score 4.7+

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain brand consistency

  • Comfortable with remote collaboration via Slack, video calls, and project management tools
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating range across marketing asset types
Nice to Have
  • Experience working with B2B technology brands

title: Regulatory and Trade Compliance Lead (Seeds & Traits)
description:
Position Overview

This role leads the import, export, and domestic logistics for biological materials to support the R&D and Regulatory teams in Brazil. Operating initially as a high-level individual contributor, the Regulatory and Trade Compliance Lead will be the technical reference within the company, responsible for designing, compliance-checking, and executing the cross-border and domestic movement of research materials from scratch.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute the end-to-end import and export processes biological materials, ensuring full compliance with Brazilian and international trade regulations.
  • Act as the primary technical interface with Brazilian authorities, particularly MAPA (Ministério da Agricultura e Pecuária) managing import permits (LI), and phytosanitary certificates.
  • Oversee and coordinate the secure, compliant domestic transport and logistics of biological materials between R&D sites, laboratories, and field trial sites in Brazil.
  • Partner closely with internal R&D and Regulatory Affairs teams to streamline the flow of materials needed for research, breeding, and biosafety trials.
  • Manage external partners, including customs brokers, specialized logistics providers, and laboratories, to ensure speed and regulatory compliance in all operations.
  • Establish internal standard operating procedures (SOPs) for trade compliance, traceability, and material handling within the organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Agronomy, Biology, Biotechnology, International Trade, or related disciplines.
  • Solid hands-on experience in import/export operations within the agricultural sector, with a strong focus on seeds.
  • Deep knowledge of MAPA regulations, phytosanitary requirements, post-entry quarantine procedures, and domestic transit rules for biological materials.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously, build processes from the ground up, and act as a strategic advisor to scientific teams.
  • Fluent in English; Portuguese required.

title: Structural Analysis Engineer - Mid Level
description:
Summary Description

We are looking for a Mid-Level Structural Analysis Engineer to support aerospace and/or aeronautical engineering projects, with a focus on metallic and/or composite structures. The engineer will be responsible for performing static analysis, fatigue analysis, and damage tolerance evaluations to support product development, certification, modifications, and in-service support activities.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in structural calculations, interpretation of technical requirements, engineering drawings, finite element modeling, and technical report preparation. A solid understanding of strength of materials, structural mechanics, margins of safety, and structural substantiation methods is required.

Key Responsibilities:

- Perform static analysis of aircraft structures using hand calculations and/or finite element methods.

- Support fatigue and structural life assessments under technical guidance.

- Support damage tolerance evaluations, including crack growth assessment and inspection criteria.

- Prepare finite element models, loads, boundary conditions, and basic correlation activities.

- Prepare clear and traceable technical reports aligned with certification requirements.

- Interface with design, loads, materials, certification, manufacturing, and product support teams.

Desired Qualifications:

- Degree in Aeronautical, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.

- Approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in structural analysis.

- Experience with tools such as Nastran, Patran, FEMAP, HyperMesh, Abaqus, ANSYS, or similar.

- Experience with metallic and/or composite aircraft structures.

- Knowledge of static strength, fatigue, damage tolerance, structural margins, and certification documentation.

- Technical English for reading, report writing, and engineering communication.

description:

title: Ports and Shipping Specialist
description:
Senior Non-Key Expert – Ports and Shipping Specialist

About NTU International A/S

NTU International A/S is a leading international consulting company providing project management and technical advisory services worldwide. NTU works extensively with European Union institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, and public sector clients across transport, infrastructure, urban development, climate resilience, governance, and sustainable investment.

NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 – EC-INTPA/2026/EA-RP/0006.”

The overall objective of the project is to support the global transition towards inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in partner countries, in line with the Global Gateway strategy and the European Green Deal ’ s geopolitical offer .

The contract will involve the mobilisation of experts for technical assistance missions worldwide, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia and the Pacific .

The intended start date is January 2027 , with an implementation period of 48 months .

In this context, NTU International is seeking a highly qualified Senior Non-Key Expert – Ports and Shipping Specialist to support technical, policy, institutional and investment-related assignments in the maritime and inland waterways sectors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting the identification, preparation and implementation of maritime, port and inland waterways infrastructure projects.
  • Conducting feasibility studies, technical assessments, project design reviews and investment-related analyses.
  • Supporting port and logistics master planning, connectivity planning and multimodal transport integration.
  • Advising on port infrastructure development, maritime transport services and inland waterways systems.
  • Supporting procurement, tendering, implementation supervision, operation and maintenance planning.
  • Promoting sustainable maritime transport and port decarbonisation measures.
  • Supporting energy efficiency, electrification of port operations, shore-side electricity, renewable fuels and emissions reduction initiatives.
  • Advising on green port infrastructure, circular economy approaches and environmental performance.
  • Supporting climate resilience, disaster risk reduction and sustainability considerations in maritime infrastructure.
  • Contributing to policy, regulatory and institutional reforms in the maritime sector.
  • Supporting capacity building for public authorities, port authorities, operators and other sector stakeholders.
  • Promoting European standards, technical practices and sustainability requirements in partner countries.
  • Supporting stakeholder coordination involving public authorities, port authorities, operators, contractors, supervising engineers, IFIs and development partners.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Master’s degree or equivalent diploma in maritime engineering, maritime sciences, port engineering, transport engineering, logistics , or another directly related discipline.
  • Excellent knowledge of the maritime and inland waterways sectors, including ports, maritime transport, inland waterways transport and related policies and good practices.
  • Good understanding of sustainable transport, infrastructure development, climate resilience and environmental and social considerations.
  • Knowledge of development aid delivery methods.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Excellent computer skills.

General Professional Experience

  • At least 15 years of general professional experience in the maritime sector.
  • Proven experience managing complex assignments involving multiple stakeholders, including public authorities, port authorities, operators, contractors, supervising engineers and development partners.
  • Proven professional experience across the project cycle of maritime infrastructure and services investments, including feasibility studies, detailed design, tendering/procurement support, implementation, operation and maintenance planning.
  • Experience applying international and European standards and good practices related to maritime transport and port infrastructure, including technical quality, safety, environmental and social compliance, climate resilience and sustainability.

Specific Professional Experience

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in the planning, design, supervision or management of maritime and/or port infrastructure and services.
  • At least 3 years of proven professional experience in sustainable maritime transport and port decarbonisation, including areas such as energy efficiency, electrification of port operations, shore-side electricity, green port infrastructure, renewable fuels, emissions reduction measures, circular approaches, climate resilience and environmental performance of ports.
  • Professional experience related to the G20 Principles for Quality Infrastructure Investment in the maritime sector, including feasibility studies, project design, port and logistics planning, safety, environmental and social considerations, maintenance, procurement, connectivity, interoperability and master plan development.

Assets

  • Professional experience in developing countries (in situ);
  • Professional experience in providing support to governance / capacity building in the maritime sector;
  • Professional experience with the EU rules and procedures.

Language Requirements

  • English proficiency at C1 level is mandatory.
  • French at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.
  • Spanish at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.

Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on specific project requirements, availability and matching qualifications. Selected experts may be mobilised for short-term technical assistance missions in partner countries globally. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: IP Lawyer (In-House, Brazil)
description:
Hello!

We are looking for an experienced and proactive IP Lawyer to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.

This is a remote-first position, offering flexibility while working closely with our international legal and business teams. However, the role requires regular attendance at court hearings, enforcement actions, and raids in São Paulo. Therefore, candidates must reside in the city of São Paulo or its metropolitan area.

You'll work directly on protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands through a combination of civil, criminal, and administrative IP enforcement.

The position focuses on hands-on IP enforcement, including drafting and sending claims, managing pre-litigation negotiations, coordinating enforcement actions with public authorities, representing clients in civil and criminal proceedings, and recovering monetary compensation from infringers.

Who are we?

BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries such as fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA, and Latin America, and we are now expanding our legal team in Brazil.

What you will do:

  • Identify and monitor IP infringements throughout Brazil;
  • Draft and send cease-and-desist letters, legal claims, and negotiate settlements;
  • Represent rights holders in pre-litigation, civil litigation, and criminal IP proceedings;
  • Coordinate and participate in search and seizure operations (raids) and enforcement actions with local authorities (Police, Customs, Public Prosecutor's Office, regulatory agencies, etc.);
  • Draft and file powers of attorney, affidavits, criminal complaints, petitions, and litigation documents;
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with law enforcement agencies, courts, investigators, and service providers;
  • Recover monetary compensation through settlements or court decisions;
  • Support the company's legal and business operations in Brazil (contracts, compliance, office setup, banking, and corporate matters, as needed).

What we expect from you:

  • Law degree and admission to the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB);
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Intellectual Property (either in-house or at a law firm);
  • Proven experience with IP enforcement, including:
  • Civil litigation;
  • Criminal IP matters, including search and seizure actions, criminal complaints, anti-counterfeiting investigations, and interactions with police and prosecutors;
  • Experience coordinating enforcement actions with public authorities;
  • Strong legal drafting, negotiation, and communication skills;
  • Fluent Portuguese and professional English (written and spoken);
  • Highly organized, proactive, and able to work independently in a global environment;
  • Must reside in São Paulo (city or metropolitan area) due to the need for in-person attendance at courts, hearings, and enforcement operations.

What We Offer:

  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape BrandMonitor's legal operations in Brazil;
  • Remote-first work environment with flexibility;
  • Meaningful impact in the global fight against counterfeiting and intellectual property violations;
  • Career growth within a fast-growing international legal-tech company.

Join BrandMonitor and help protect some of the world's leading brands while making a real impact in the fight against counterfeiting.

* *Ensino Médio completo* (Superior em curso será um diferencial que amamos).

* *Perfil Comunicador:* Alguém que saiba negociar, tenha empatia e muita proatividade.

---

### * O que oferecemos para quem é fera:*

* *Salário Fixo:* R$ 1.676,51 (Remuneração competitiva com o mercado administrativo/comercial).

* *Vale Alimentação/Refeição:* R$ 20,00 por dia no restaurante parceiro.

* *Mobilidade:* Você escolhe entre *Vale Transporte* ou *Auxílio Combustível*.

*Benefícios Extras (Só quem é do time tem!):*

* *Day Off* no seu aniversário – para você comemorar como merece.

* *Desconto Exclusivo* na proteção do seu próprio veículo.

* *Bônus por meta* bons resultados merece bonificação.

* *Plano de Carreira* estruturado para quem quer voar alto.

---

*Topa o desafio?*

Se você tem vontade de vencer e quer transformar o mercado de proteção veicular conosco, envie seu currículo agora!

title: Bilingual English Teacher - Remote Role [T]
description:
Role Overview

We are currently inviting qualified ESL teachers to apply for a remote instructional role supporting international learners through our structured online teaching platform.

This is a contract-based teaching position offering self-managed scheduling within a professional global education environment.

Why Join Us

  1. Remote teaching structure
  2. Self-managed scheduling
  3. Access to professional development opportunities
  4. Supportive global educator network
  5. Dedicated online teaching portal

Core Requirements

· Bachelor’s Degree or higher

· Recognized English teaching certification (TESOL / TEFL / TESL – CELTA or equivalent preferred)

· Minimum of 2 years ESL teaching experience

· Demonstrated commitment to professional growth and teaching excellence

Professional Qualifications (Preferred)

· Advanced ESL qualifications (Level 5 equivalent or higher such as CELTA, TKT, DipTESOL, PGCE, MEd, PhDEd)

· Continuous professional development (CPD) participation

· Experience with international learners

Language Capability Requirements

· English proficiency at CEFR C2 (or equivalent) is required

· Proficiency in at least one additional language at CEFR B1+ or higher is strongly preferred

﻿Teaching Scope

You may support either young learners or adult learners depending on teaching allocation.

Students may include:

  1. School-aged learners
  2. University students
  3. Working professionals
  4. Adult learners seeking conversational fluency

All curriculum materials are provided and accessible in advance of teaching sessions.

Next Step

  • Qualified candidates are invited to submit their resume for review.

  • Power Query e Power BI (nível básico/intermediário);

title: HR Generalist Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a HR Generalist Specialist/Coordinator who is committed and passionate about people! This role will be responsible for the full scope of HR generalist functions -- from employee lifecycle management, to talent development, to business partnering with local leadership and supporting initiatives from our HQ in Singapore.

Our ideal candidate would be able to run with us, adapt to our employees' needs, and stay humble throughout. If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we'd love to work with you!

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Exclusivity contract required.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary HR point of contact for all Garena Brazil employees, providing guidance and support across the full employee lifecycle (onboarding, performance management, development, offboarding)
  • Manage and oversee HR operations, ensuring compliance with CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws), Collective Labor Agreement, and applicable regulations
  • Lead employee engagement initiatives, including surveys, action planning, and team-level interventions
  • Oversee internal communications strategy and execution for the BR office
  • Manage Learning & Development programs, including budget administration, internal training, and vendor coordination
  • Partner with business leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, and talent management
  • Conduct compensation analysis and support salary proposals for new hires and internal movements
  • Coordinate performance review cycles (mid-year and year-end conversations)
  • Manage employee relations matters independently, including investigations, disciplinary actions, and conflict resolution
  • Represent the BR People team in cross-functional projects and HQ-driven initiatives
  • Contribute to People team related AI initiatives

Main job requirements:

  • 8+ years' experience in HR, with at least 3 years in a generalist or HR business partner capacity
  • Superior/higher degree completed
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian labor law (CLT) and employment regulations is a must
  • Strong background in HR Operations is a must
  • Proven experience managing the full employee lifecycle independently
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) is a must
  • Strong stakeholder management skills - able to influence and advise senior leaders
  • Strong ethics, discretion, and judgment in handling sensitive matters
  • Experience with employee engagement, L&D, and talent development
  • Ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills is a must
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Experience in the tech or gaming industry is a plus
  • Experience in using or developing AI solutions
  • Team player with a collaborative mindset
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).
